name: Capital One Spark Cash Plus

welcome_offer.description: Earn a one-time $2,000 cash bonus and, for a limited time, a $500 Capital One Business Travel credit after spending $30,000 on purchases within the first 3 months. Plus, earn an additional $2,000 cash bonus for every $500,000 spent during the first year.
notes: Capital One official/searchable page and TPG July 2026 coverage support the $2,000 cash bonus + limited-time $500 Business Travel credit after $30,000/3 months, plus $2,000 per $500k first-year spend.

earning_rates.notes: Unlimited 2% cash back on every purchase, every day

earning_rates.category: Hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel
earning_rates.notes: 5% on Capital One Business Travel bookings

other_benefits: Up to $100,000 in free global travel accident insurance

sources.notes: Forbes: high 2% cash-back rate on all purchases, unlimited 5% on Capital One Business Travel
The Points Guy: great cash back for high-spending businesses, 2% on all purchases
CNN Underscored: competitive 2% rate, employee cards earn 2%
Official Spark Cash Plus page: $2,000 cash bonus after $30,000/3 months plus additional $2,000 per $500k first-year spend.
TPG July 2026 Spark Cash lineup confirms $2,000 + $500 Business Travel credit limited-time Spark Cash Plus offer.

notes: Charge card (balance must be paid in full monthly). $150 annual fee. 2% unlimited cash back; 5% on hotels/rental cars through Capital One Business Travel. Updated 2026-08-06 for elevated $2,000 + $500 travel-credit offer.
